summary: The document describes a gold-catalyzed formal [3+2] cycloaddition between ynamides and isoxazoles to synthesize 2-aminopyrroles. The main article includes 4 tables detailing reaction optimization and substrate scope, along with 3 schemes and several equations illustrating the proposed atom-economic gold carbene mechanism.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Synthetic design for the atom-economic generation of a -imino gold carbenes: formation of 2-aminopyrroles 3 through goldcatalyzed formal [3+2] cycloaddition between ynamides 1 and isoxazoles 2 .
items.description: This scheme outlines the conceptual design for generating gold carbenes from ynamides and isoxazoles to form 2-aminopyrroles.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Plausible reaction mechanism. Theoretical investigations on the reaction pathways for the formation of product 3g (Table 2, entry 7): relative free energies ( D G sol, in kcal mol 1 ) of key intermediates and transition states were computed at the M06/6-31+G(d)/SDD level in 1,2-dichloroethane at 298 K.
items.description: A detailed mechanistic pathway supported by DFT calculations, showing the formation of gold carbene and subsequent cyclization.
